name: BANK-04 restart cancellation and completed-transfer finality

tests.name: Reauthenticate scheduler admin after serving-server restart

data.sql: SELECT bank_orders_id,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM next_run_at)::bigint FROM bank_orders WHERE player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='bank04_payer_qa') ORDER BY bank_orders_id DESC LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Reschedule only standing-order handler at persisted due time

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=(name='bank_standing_orders_tick'),next_due_at=CASE WHEN name='bank_standing_orders_tick' THEN to_timestamp(@{bank04_next_due}) ELSE next_due_at END;

tests.name: Run actual scheduler against now-missing recipient
Order is cancelled and historical completed transfer remains final

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT enabled=FALSE FROM bank_orders WHERE bank_orders_id=@{bank04_order_id}) AND (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM bank_order_occurrences WHERE bank_orders_id=@{bank04_order_id} AND outcome='paid' AND amount=10) AND (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM bank_order_occurrences WHERE bank_orders_id=@{bank04_order_id} AND outcome='cancelled_invalid_recipient' AND amount=10) AND (SELECT COUNT(*)=2 FROM bank_transactions WHERE tx_group_id LIKE 'bank-order-'||@{bank04_order_id}||'-%') AND (SELECT balance=40 FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='bank04_payer_qa') AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE) AND (SELECT balance=10 FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='bank04_recipient_qa') AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Payer can list the durably disabled order
No duplicate cancellation or reversed transfer after restart retry

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM bank_order_occurrences WHERE bank_orders_id=@{bank04_order_id} AND outcome='cancelled_invalid_recipient') AND (SELECT COUNT(*)=2 FROM bank_transactions WHERE tx_group_id LIKE 'bank-order-'||@{bank04_order_id}||'-%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
